definitions.explanation: The organ of smell and breathing on the face.

examples.english: To have a high nose; to be proud.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鼻水|はなみず}→鼻水：04430_hanamizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。

examples.english: Dogs have a good sense of smell.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{鼻|はな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{近|ちか}づけて→近づける：02074_chikazukeru⟧⟦{匂|にお}い→匂い：00874_nioi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かいだ→嗅ぐ：02036_kagu⟧。
examples.english: I brought my nose close to the flower and smelled it.

notes:
{鼻|はな} refers to the nose.

NOTE ON HOMOPHONES:
- {鼻|はな}: nose
- ⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧: flower
